function: risk round ATTACK:s versus DEFENCE:s {
  COMPARISONS: [lowest of #ATTACK and #DEFENCE]
  ATTACKER_LOSSES: 0
  DEFENDER_LOSSES: 0
  loop I over {1..COMPARISONS} {
    if I@ATTACK > I@DEFENCE {
      DEFENDER_LOSSES: DEFENDER_LOSSES + 1
    }
    else {
      ATTACKER_LOSSES: ATTACKER_LOSSES + 1
    }
  }
  result: [tuple ATTACKER_LOSSES DEFENDER_LOSSES]
}
ROUND: [risk round 3d6 versus 2d6]
output ROUND named "risk round"

\\\ A user function projects the tuple pool through an element-shaped
\\\ parameter.
function: project I:n of VALUE:n { result: [field I of VALUE] }
output [project 1 of ROUND] named "attacker losses"
output [project 2 of ROUND] named "defender losses"

output 2d{[tuple 1 0], [tuple 0 1]} named "multidimensional die"
A: d{[tuple 1 0], [tuple 0 1]}
B: d{[tuple 1 0], [tuple 0 1]}
output A + B named "added tuple dice"
output 0d{[tuple 1 2], [tuple 3 4]} named "zero tuple dice"
output -2d{[tuple 1 0], [tuple 0 1]} named "negative tuple dice"

output d{[tuple 5 6]:0} named "typed empty tuple"

EMPTY: 2d{}
function: identity VALUE:n { result: VALUE }
output EMPTY + EMPTY + [tuple 1 2] named "left identities"
output [tuple 1 2] + EMPTY + EMPTY named "right identities"
output [identity EMPTY] + [tuple 1 2] named "function identity"
output EMPTY + EMPTY named "defaulted identity"
output 2d{} + 2d{[tuple (d2) (d2)]} named "identity plus tuple die"
output 2d{[tuple (d2) (d2)]} named "tuple die"
output 2d{[tuple 9 8]:0} + [tuple 1 2] named "typed empty plus tuple"

function: maybe tuple CONDITION:n {
  if CONDITION { result: [tuple 1 2] }
  result: [identity 2d{}]
}
output [maybe tuple d{0, 1}] named "merged identity and tuple"
